result.note: Tests the place in the news (Strait of Hormuz, Khasab in Oman) and the MEA response; avoids the crew numbers, where the story is internally inconsistent.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, a projectile struck the commercial vessel MT On Peace in the Strait of Hormuz, injuring several Indian sailors. Consider the following statements about this incident:
items: The vessel was flagged in Panama.
The Ministry of External Affairs statement identified the attacker.
The injured crew were evacuated to Khasab in Oman for treatment.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong: the MEA condemned the attack and called the targeting of shipping a cause of deep concern, but its statement did not name an attacker. The strike followed a 13 September 2026 attack on a merchant vessel off Oman with 14 Indians aboard.
questions.source: Omani authorities helped evacuate the injured, who are being treated in Khasab, Oman.
